This is scalar fact cover, not whole pipeline deletion equivalence.
predicates.correlatedSTAR: Same full headers/interface/direction; STAR initial and output; same residual appended on both input/output paths. Geometry candidate only: ancestor native inputs can produce different layers.

predicates.sameLayerDemandANY: Same complete P/interface; DEMAND/ANY proper output prefix and full mark compatibility. This is an existing scalar same-layer fact-cover cell, but it does not itself certify record removal or observer equivalence.

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.external

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.Target
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.StoreFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.Record

private fun q(s: String): String = "\"" + s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"").replace("\n", "\\n") + "\""
private fun json(x: Any?): String = when (x) {
    null -> "null"
    is String -> q(x)
    is Boolean, is Number -> x.toString()
    is Map<*, *> -> x.entries.joinToString(",", "{", "}") { q(it.key.toString()) + ":" + json(it.value) }
    is Iterable<*> -> x.joinToString(",", "[", "]") { json(it) }
    else -> error("No JSON conversion for " + x.javaClass)
}
private class Output : LocalRelationOut {
    val data = ArrayList<Pair<PremiseKey, Facts>>()
    val targets = ArrayList<Pair<PremiseKey, Target>>()
    val requests = ArrayList<TaintMark>()
    override fun data(original: PremiseKey, value: Facts) { data += original to value }
    override fun target(original: PremiseKey, target: Target) { targets += original to target }
    override fun markRequest(mark: TaintMark) { requests += mark }
}
fun main() {
    val f = StoreFixtures()
    val ap = f.manager
    val ops = f.ops
    val p = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
    val z = AccessPathBase.Return
    val ff = f.field("f")
    val gg = f.field("g")
    val t = f.mark("T")
    val mode = ApMode(false, Direction.FORWARD, 10)
    val application = LocalRelationApplication(ops, mode)
    fun pat(b: AccessPathBase, path: List<Int> = emptyList(), tail: Tail = Tail.STAR,
            mark: MarkSlot = MarkSlot.STAR, e: ExclusionSet = ExclusionSet.Empty) = f.pattern(b, path, tail, mark, e)
    fun fact(b: AccessPathBase, path: List<Int> = emptyList(), tail: Tail = Tail.STAR,
             mark: MarkSlot = MarkSlot.STAR, e: ExclusionSet = ExclusionSet.Empty,
             layer: Layer = Layer.NORMAL) = f.fact(b, path, tail, mark, e, layer)
    fun row(ip: List<Int>, op: List<Int>, inputE: ExclusionSet = ExclusionSet.Empty,
            outputMx: MarkExclusions = MarkExclusions.EMPTY) = Record(f.method, Direction.FORWARD,
        ap.initial(pat(p, ip, e = inputE)), fact(z, op, mark = MarkSlot.Star(outputMx)))
    val s = row(emptyList(), emptyList())
    val l = row(listOf(ff), listOf(ff))
    val u = row(listOf(ff), emptyList())
    fun pp(p: Pattern): Map<String, Any?> = linkedMapOf("base" to p.fact.base.toString(), "path" to p.fact.path,
        "tail" to p.fact.tail.name, "E" to (p.exclusion as? ExclusionSet.Concrete)?.ids?.toList().orEmpty(),
        "mark" to when (val m = p.fact.mark) { is MarkSlot.Concrete -> linkedMapOf("kind" to "CONCRETE", "id" to m.mark.id)
            is MarkSlot.Star -> linkedMapOf("kind" to "FLOW", "mx" to m.excluded.ids.toList()) })
    fun fs(value: Facts): Map<String, Any?> = linkedMapOf("layer" to value.layer.name,
        "rows" to ops.leaves(value).map(::pp).toList(),
        "hasProtection" to (value is TaintTree && value.nonSubsumable != null))
    fun rs(r: Record): Map<String, Any?> = linkedMapOf("input" to pp(r.premise.toPattern()), "output" to fs(r.conclusion))
    val cases = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
    fun apply(name: String, r: Record, a: Facts): Output {
        val original = if (a is FlowTree) ap.initial(pat(p)) else ap.initial(pat(p, tail = Tail.EXACT, mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(t)))
        val out = Output()
        val applied = application.applyRecord(a, original, r, out)
        cases += linkedMapOf("name" to name, "record" to rs(r), "actual" to fs(a), "original" to pp(original.toPattern()),
            "applied" to applied, "outputs" to out.data.map { fs(it.second) },
            "originalPreserved" to out.data.all { it.first === original },
            "requests" to out.requests.map { it.id }, "targets" to out.targets.map { it.second.toString() })
        return out
    }
    val exact = fact(p, listOf(ff, gg), Tail.EXACT, MarkSlot.Concrete(t))
    val se = apply("short/exact-descendant", s, exact)
    val le = apply("correlated-long/exact-descendant", l, exact)
    val ue = apply("uncorrelated-long/exact-descendant", u, exact)
    check(se.data.single().second == le.data.single().second)
    check(se.data.single().second != ue.data.single().second)
    check(ops.leaves(se.data.single().second).single().fact.path == listOf(ff, gg))
    check(ops.leaves(ue.data.single().second).single().fact.path == listOf(gg))
    check(se.data.single().second.layer == Layer.NORMAL)
    val above = fact(p)
    val sa = apply("short/above-normal-STAR", s, above)
    val la = apply("correlated-long/above-normal-STAR", l, above)
    check(sa.data.single().second.layer == Layer.NORMAL)
    check(ops.leaves(sa.data.single().second).single().fact.tail == Tail.STAR)
    check(la.data.single().second.layer == Layer.DEMAND)
    check(ops.leaves(la.data.single().second).single().fact.path == listOf(ff))
    check(ops.leaves(la.data.single().second).single().fact.tail == Tail.ANY)
    val may = fact(p, tail = Tail.ANY, layer = Layer.DEMAND)
    val sm = apply("short/above-DEMAND-ANY", s, may)
    val lm = apply("correlated-long/above-DEMAND-ANY", l, may)
    val sp = ops.leaves(sm.data.single().second).single()
    val lp = ops.leaves(lm.data.single().second).single()
    check(subsumes(Conclusion(sp.fact, sp.exclusion, true), Conclusion(lp.fact, lp.exclusion, true)))
    val mx = row(emptyList(), emptyList(), outputMx = MarkExclusions.of(ap.marks, t))
    val mxout = apply("short-excluding-T/exact-descendant-T", mx, exact)
    check(mxout.data.isEmpty())
    val excluded = row(emptyList(), emptyList(), inputE = ExclusionSet.of(ff))
    val eout = apply("short-excluding-f/exact-descendant", excluded, exact)
    check(eout.data.isEmpty())
    check(cases.all { (it["requests"] as List<*>).isEmpty() && (it["targets"] as List<*>).isEmpty() })
    println(json(linkedMapOf("state" to "PASS", "nativeRuntime" to "52f32dd437d438aec4a700a02c18d94c31d58093",
        "mode" to "later FULL FORWARD", "fieldLimit" to 10, "normalRecords" to true,
        "fields" to linkedMapOf(ff.toString() to "Box#f", gg.toString() to "Box#g"), "T" to t.id,
        "cases" to cases,
        "claims" to listOf("Correlated short/long agree on exact descendant concrete input",
            "Uncorrelated path rewrite is not covered by identity",
            "Above NORMAL STAR creates different NORMAL-versus-DEMAND native outputs",
            "DEMAND ANY short result fact-subsumes long descendant result on this input",
            "Full mark exclusions and field exclusions can invalidate coverage",
            "No mark-request or Target callback in the later-forward FLOW cell"))))
}

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.external
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.StoreFixtures

private fun jq(s: String): String = "\"" + s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\""
private fun jj(x: Any?): String = when (x) {
    null -> "null"
    is String -> jq(x)
    is Boolean, is Number -> x.toString()
    is Map<*, *> -> x.entries.joinToString(",", "{", "}") { jq(it.key.toString()) + ":" + jj(it.value) }
    is Iterable<*> -> x.joinToString(",", "[", "]") { jj(it) }
    else -> error("No JSON conversion")
}
fun main() {
    val f = StoreFixtures()
    val ap = f.manager
    val ops = f.ops
    val p = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
    val q = AccessPathBase.Return
    val a = f.field("f")
    val b = f.field("g")
    val t = f.mark("T")
    val cases = ArrayList<Map<String, Any?>>()
    fun value(path: List<Int>, e: ExclusionSet, mx: MarkExclusions) =
        f.fact(q, path, Tail.ANY_TAINT, MarkSlot.Star(mx), e) as FlowTree
    fun conclusion(v: Facts): Conclusion {
        val s = ops.leaves(v).single()
        return Conclusion(s.fact, s.exclusion, v.layer == Layer.DEMAND)
    }
    fun desc(v: FlowTree): Map<String, Any?> = linkedMapOf("base" to v.base.toString(),
        "paths" to ops.leaves(v).map { it.fact.path }.toList(), "tail" to v.tail.name,
        "layer" to v.layer.name, "E" to (v.exclusion as? ExclusionSet.Concrete)?.ids?.toList().orEmpty(),
        "mx" to v.markExclusion.ids.toList())
    fun run(name: String, first: FlowTree, second: FlowTree, expectedReference: Boolean,
            expectedDelta: Boolean = true) {
        val ref = subsumes(conclusion(first), conclusion(second))
        check(ref == expectedReference) { "$name reference=$ref" }
        val group = FlowGroup(ap, ap.newInterners().flow)
        check(group.add(first) != null)
        val delta = group.add(second)
        check((delta != null) == expectedDelta) { "$name delta=$delta" }
        cases += linkedMapOf("name" to name, "broad" to desc(first), "narrow" to desc(second),
            "scalarReferenceSubsumes" to ref, "nativeFlowGroupDeltaExists" to (delta != null),
            "delta" to delta?.let(::desc), "currentStored" to group.all().map(::desc).toList())
    }
    val empty = ExclusionSet.Empty
    val none = MarkExclusions.EMPTY
    val mxT = MarkExclusions.of(ap.marks, t)
    run("same-premise-root-MUST-covers-descendant-MUST", value(emptyList(),empty,none), value(listOf(a),empty,none), true)
    run("same-premise-unrelated-root-E-admits-f", value(emptyList(),ExclusionSet.of(b),none), value(listOf(a),empty,none), true)
    run("same-premise-root-E-excludes-f", value(emptyList(),ExclusionSet.of(a),none), value(listOf(a),empty,none), false)
    run("same-premise-broad-mx-subset", value(emptyList(),empty,none), value(listOf(a),empty,mxT), true)
    run("same-premise-broad-mx-excludes-T", value(emptyList(),empty,mxT), value(listOf(a),empty,none), false)
    run("same-path-MUST-E-subset-existing-cover", value(emptyList(),empty,none), value(emptyList(),ExclusionSet.of(a),none), true, false)
    run("same-path-MUST-mx-subset-existing-cover", value(emptyList(),empty,none), value(emptyList(),empty,mxT), true, false)
    val rootI = ap.initial(f.pattern(p, tail = Tail.ANY_TAINT, mark = MarkSlot.STAR))
    val fieldI = ap.initial(f.pattern(p, listOf(a), Tail.ANY_TAINT, MarkSlot.STAR))
    val fieldActual = f.fact(p, listOf(a), Tail.ANY_TAINT, MarkSlot.STAR)
    val mode = ApMode(false, Direction.FORWARD, 10)
    val rootMatch = ops.satisfying(fieldActual, rootI, mode, record = true)
    val fieldMatch = ops.satisfying(fieldActual, fieldI, mode, record = true)
    check(rootMatch == null && fieldMatch != null)
    val rootActual = f.fact(p, tail = Tail.ANY_TAINT, mark = MarkSlot.STAR)
    check(ops.satisfying(rootActual, rootI, mode, record = true) != null)
    check(ops.satisfying(rootActual, fieldI, mode, record = true) != null)
    println(jj(linkedMapOf("state" to "PASS", "runtimeRevision" to "52f32dd437d438aec4a700a02c18d94c31d58093",
        "cases" to cases, "fieldIds" to linkedMapOf(a.toString() to "Box#f",b.toString() to "Box#g"),"T" to t.id,
        "acrossPremiseNegative" to linkedMapOf("actual" to "arg0.f.MUST/FLOW NORMAL", "rootMUSTPremiseMatches" to false,
            "fieldMUSTPremiseMatches" to true, "uniformRootActualMatchesBoth" to true),

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.external
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.Target
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.StoreFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.graph.*

private fun sq(s:String)="\""+s.replace("\\","\\\\").replace("\"","\\\"")+"\""
private fun sj(x:Any?):String=when(x){null->"null";is String->sq(x);is Number,is Boolean->x.toString();is Map<*,*>->x.entries.joinToString(",","{","}"){sq(it.key.toString())+":"+sj(it.value)};is Iterable<*>->x.joinToString(",","[","]"){sj(it)};else->error("JSON")}
private class SavedOut:LocalRelationOut{
 val data=ArrayList<Pair<PremiseKey,Facts>>();val targets=ArrayList<String>();val requests=ArrayList<Int>()
 override fun data(original:PremiseKey,value:Facts){data+=original to value}
 override fun target(original:PremiseKey,target:Target){targets+=target.toString()}
 override fun markRequest(mark:TaintMark){requests+=mark.id}
}
fun main(){
 val f=StoreFixtures();val ap=f.manager;val ops=f.ops
 val x=AccessPathBase.LocalVar(23);val y=AccessPathBase.LocalVar(18)
 val pattern=792;val regex=796;val cs=1008;val bytes=160
 val t=f.mark("T");val u=f.mark("U");val mx=MarkExclusions.of(ap.marks,listOf(t,u))
 val initial=ap.initial(f.pattern(x,listOf(pattern,regex),Tail.ANY_TAINT,MarkSlot.STAR))
 val shapeScope=BlockScope(BlockId(2),PortId(80))
 fun row(path:List<Int>,e:ExclusionSet=ExclusionSet.Empty)=Record(f.method,Direction.FORWARD,initial,
  f.fact(y,path,Tail.ANY_TAINT,MarkSlot.Star(mx),e),shapeScope,PortId(80))
 val short=row(listOf(cs));val long=row(listOf(cs,bytes))
 val actual=f.fact(y,listOf(cs),Tail.ANY,MarkSlot.STAR,layer=Layer.DEMAND)
 val original=ap.initial(f.pattern(y,listOf(cs),Tail.ANY,MarkSlot.STAR))
 val app=LocalRelationApplication(ops,ApMode(false,Direction.BACKWARD,5))
 fun pat(p:Pattern):Map<String,Any?> = linkedMapOf("base" to  p.fact.base.toString(),"path" to  p.fact.path,"tail" to  p.fact.tail.name,
  "E" to (p.exclusion as? ExclusionSet.Concrete)?.ids?.toList().orEmpty(),"mark" to  when(val m=p.fact.mark){is MarkSlot.Star->linkedMapOf("kind" to "FLOW","mx" to  m.excluded.ids.toList());is MarkSlot.Concrete->linkedMapOf("kind" to "CONCRETE","id" to  m.mark.id)})
 fun fact(v:Facts):Map<String,Any?> = linkedMapOf("layer" to  v.layer.name,"rows" to  ops.leaves(v).map(::pat).toList(),"protected" to (v is TaintTree&&v.nonSubsumable!=null))
 fun apply(r:Record,a:Facts,p:PremiseKey):Pair<Map<String,Any?>,SavedOut>{
  val out=SavedOut();var view:RecordLeafView?=null
  r.forEachReversedAt(ops.leaves(a).single()){v,protected->check(view==null);view=v;app.applyRecordView(a,p,v,protected,out)}
  val v=checkNotNull(view)
  val grows=loopFieldLength(Pattern(v.result.fact,v.result.exclusion))>loopFieldLength(v.premise)
  return linkedMapOf("forwardPremise" to  pat(r.premise.toPattern()),"forwardOutputs" to  fact(r.conclusion),
   "forwardScope" to  r.scope.toString(),"forwardExit" to  r.exit?.ordinal,"reverseScope" to  r.scopeIn(Direction.BACKWARD).toString(),"reverseExit" to  r.exitIn(Direction.BACKWARD)?.ordinal,
   "viewPremise" to  pat(v.premise),"viewResult" to  pat(Pattern(v.result.fact,v.result.exclusion)),"viewDemand" to  v.result.demand,
   "storedShapeGrows" to  grows,"actual" to  fact(a),"P" to  p.members.map{pat(it.toPattern())},
   "outputs" to  out.data.map{fact(it.second)},"originalPreserved" to  out.data.all{it.first===p},"targets" to  out.targets,"requests" to  out.requests) to out
 }
 val(s,so)=apply(short,actual,original);val(l,lo)=apply(long,actual,original)
 check(so.data.single().second==lo.data.single().second)
 check(s["storedShapeGrows"]==true&&l["storedShapeGrows"]==false)
 check(so.data.single().second.layer==Layer.DEMAND)
 check(ops.leaves(so.data.single().second).single().fact.path==listOf(pattern,regex))
 check(so.requests.isEmpty()&&lo.requests.isEmpty()&&so.targets.isEmpty()&&lo.targets.isEmpty())
 val ff=f.field("f");val gg=f.field("g");val hh=f.field("h")
 val es=row(emptyList(),ExclusionSet.of(hh));val el=row(listOf(ff))
 val eactual=f.fact(y,tail=Tail.STAR,mark=MarkSlot.STAR,exclusion=ExclusionSet.of(gg))
 val ep=ap.initial(f.pattern(y,tail=Tail.STAR,mark=MarkSlot.STAR,exclusion=ExclusionSet.of(gg)))
 val(e1,e1o)=apply(es,eactual,ep);val(e2,e2o)=apply(el,eactual,ep)
 check(e1o.data.isEmpty()&&e2o.data.isNotEmpty())
 println(sj(linkedMapOf("state" to "PASS","runtimeRevision" to "52f32dd437d438aec4a700a02c18d94c31d58093",
  "capturedShape" to "post5 constrained decoder block2 entry80 exit80, Pvar23.[Matcher.pattern,Pattern.regex].MUST; Svar18.CS.MUST; Lvar18.CS.StringBytes.MUST",
  "renaming" to  linkedMapOf("fieldIds" to "retained exact captured integers", "capturedMx75" to  t.id,"capturedMx76" to  u.id,"note" to "Two FULL native fixture atoms bijectively rename the captured pair; this is a shape replay, not full snapshot rehydration."),
  "actualShapedShort" to  s,"actualShapedLong" to  l,"actualNativeAPOutputsIdentical" to  true,"storedGrowthFlagsDiffer" to  true,
  "incomparableE" to  linkedMapOf("fieldIds" to  linkedMapOf("f" to  ff,"g" to  gg,"h" to  hh),"short" to  e1,"long" to  e2,"shortRejectedLongAccepted" to  true),
  "limit" to "No full frozen consumer views were replayed; this proves native AP output and representation-dependent growth classification, not full-gate retention or causal attribution.")))
}

fieldCatalogForExamples.resolution: Field reads of published AccessorTable/MarkTable arrays; no catalog methods called.

limits: No repository runtime/test/build changes or analyzer reruns by this analysis; external native AP probes were separately authorized and bounded.
Diagnostic scheduling can differ from the main campaign, as the outgoing counts explicitly show. Do not substitute diagnostic counts into main performance totals.

All count percentages are membership/geometry counts, not CPU savings or avoided Work. Each complete collection is one actual native interface; different runs/snapshots are not summed as a simultaneous global inventory.
Indexed native Record objects can be historical delta packets. Counts explicitly distinguish object/packet descriptors from union memberships.
Missing post6/post7 records and some demands remain UNKNOWN. Current run6 NORMAL rows are new admitted results, not a complete post6 indexed inventory.

Per-collection exact key comparisons preserve full context. Across collections, MethodEntryPoint wrapper/context object IDs can differ despite typed value equality; current public owners omit statement runtime type, so full native-key equality is not invented from index alone. No candidate census relies on merging those wrappers.

The 456 native growth-boundary pairs are a stored representation effect. Without a full offer trace plus frozen observer views, they do not prove which pair caused main-run blow-up or what a gate would retain.
Native reverse shape probe retains exact captured field/base/port geometry but bijectively renames mx[75,76] to two FULL fixture atoms; it is not full snapshot rehydration.
Primitive scalar cover, complete relation coverage and current exact observer signatures are separate. Do not drop NORMAL/MUST/DATA records merely from spatial coverage or nonfresh completion.
Literal full atom-ID mx subset is a conservative sufficient test. Failure can remain UNKNOWN when catalog group/full relationships might establish subset.
Packed DAG leaf enumeration is complete for every processed row; explicit caps/errors would mark incomplete rows UNKNOWN. Current analyzed collections have zero such errors.
